pick.headline: United States expels 55 Soviet diplomats
pick.summary: On October 21, 1986, the United States ordered 55 Soviet diplomats to leave, saying they were intelligence officers, and cut the size of the Soviet missions to equal the American ones.
pick.significance: It was the largest expulsion of Soviet officials in US history, and the sharpest round of the spy war that followed the arrest of Gennadiy Zakharov and Nicholas Daniloff.
